segments.title: Post-Christmas Lethal Company Marathon
segments.notes: Case Blackwell hosts an extended multiplayer Lethal Company session with Kendall and friends (Ash, Fancy, Justin, Tasty, Red, Exterminator, Nathan) across multiple moons, featuring inverse teleporter experiments, tragedy mask chaos, jetpack testing, and a final raid-out.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Hosts a post-holiday Lethal Company marathon with Kendall and community friends, piloting the ship through multiple high-stakes runs.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Joins Case in-studio for the full Lethal Company session, providing comms and occasional flashlight duty.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News goes off-format for a Boxing Day Lethal Company marathon. Case Blackwell and Kendelle squad up with regulars Ash, Fancy, Justin, Tasty, and others for a four-hour salvage sprint across Experimentation, Titan, and Rend — highlights include inverse teleporter shenanigans, a tragedy mask outbreak that wipes the whole crew, a nutcracker standoff, and a commemorative jetpack purchase that explodes on maiden voyage. The broadcast closes with a raid to a late-night Lethal Company streamer.
